comparison_identity.comparator: registered no-undo / can-undo(<how>) trailing tag minus the shortest content-matched careful-English rendering (irreversibly / irrevocably; restorable from X / reversible via X) carrying the same action, path, window and loss; clausal 'this cannot be undone' renderings are out of scope by the pinned comparator genre
comparison_identity.population: 32 fresh authored pairs: 16 no-undo and 16 can-undo(<how>), balanced report/instruction shapes and path-only/windowed/holder/cost how-slots; not random natural prose
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal cell means per tokenizer then maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base; retain the no-undo and can-undo strata separately
comparison_identity.unit_span: one complete action sentence with its reversibility tag or clause

estimand_contract.contrast: registered no-undo / can-undo(<how>) trailing tag minus the shortest content-matched careful-English rendering (irreversibly / irrevocably; restorable from X / reversible via X) carrying the same action, path, window and loss; clausal 'this cannot be undone' renderings are out of scope by the pinned comparator genre
estimand_contract.population: 32 fresh authored pairs: 16 no-undo and 16 can-undo(<how>), balanced report/instruction shapes and path-only/windowed/holder/cost how-slots; not random natural prose

aggregation.rule: equal cell means per tokenizer then maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) across cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base; retain the no-undo and can-undo strata separately

estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete action sentence with its reversibility tag or clause

manifest.selection: Thirty-two wholly new prewritten action sentences across 32 domains, balanced by form and report/instruction shape; can-undo also balances four how-slot types. Frozen before tokenizer exposure.
manifest.method: After mint, count marker minus the pinned shortest careful-English comparator with tiktoken 0.14.0; report every member, the least-favourable maximum, member span, and both equal-weight source strata.
manifest.scope: Current token cost only; not whether an undo path works, restores all state, remains authorized, or improves comprehension or safety.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
